title: Quelques groupes libres de matrices
journal: Comptes Rendus de l'Académie des Sciences, Paris
coverage: Citation from the literature; no DOI, not checked online
annotation:
Usually cited for the family $A_t = \mat1t01$, $B_t = \mat10t1$: the two matrices generate a free group when $\abs{t} \ge 2$. Our proof is the same ping-pong as for Sanov's $t = 2$.

Not checked against the paper.
